name: X auto-post
description: Posts new articles to X (formerly Twitter) when they are published: a templated text in the post's language with its title, link and hashtags, fitted to 280 characters. X shows the link card from the page's Open Graph tags. Needs an X developer app with pay-per-use credits.
author: sap13ns

settings.label: API key
settings.help: The app's API Key (consumer key), in the X Developer Console → your app → Keys and tokens.

settings.label: API key secret
settings.help: The API Key Secret shown next to it.

settings.label: Access token
settings.help: Generate it after setting the app's permissions to “Read and write”, for the account the posts come from.

settings.label: Access token secret
settings.help: The Access Token Secret shown next to it.

settings.label: Text
settings.help: Placeholders: {title} {url} {excerpt} {hashtags} {site}. Empty uses “New post: {title}”, the link and the hashtags, in the post's language. Every link counts as 23 characters.

settings.label: Text for Spanish posts
settings.help: Used instead of the text above for posts in Spanish.

settings.label: Text for English posts
settings.help: Used instead of the text above for posts in English.

settings.label: Hashtags
settings.help: How many of the post's tags become hashtags. 0 adds none.

settings.label: Post
settings.help: Which content types are posted when they are published.

settings.label: Skip posts older than (hours)
settings.help: A post whose publication date is older than this is never posted, so re-publishing an old article does not announce it again.

settings.label: Dry run
settings.help: Write the text that would be posted to the activity log instead of posting it. Nothing is sent to X, so nothing is charged.
